notes.title: Version 1.11
notes.content:
[list]
[*]64 bit support. Better late than never.
[*]Multithreaded support. Significant performance increase on multi core cpus. Most noticeable when exporting in 4K.
[*]Windows XP SP3 is still supported, but you should really upgrade.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.10 , a minor update
notes.content:
All settings( preview, export file type, jpeg options, main window position and size ) are now saved and will be restored the next time you run the program.
This will reset your current config.

There are also some new examples since the 1.09 update. Most notable are the metal_*.xml.

notes.title: Version 1.06 now live.
notes.content:
This update is just memory optimizations.
[list]
[*]Added option to disable double buffering for the preview. It will save memory but you will see image tearing while tweaking the operators. Only really worth it when working at high export size.
[*]Eliminated another intermediate buffer by optimizing the Blur operator, which was the only one that used it.
[/list]

So to recap.
If, for example, you work at 4096x4096, the program uses 256 or 512MB less than the previous version.

notes.title: Version 1.05 now live.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added TIFF export. Like TGA, it is uncompressed rgba. You can choose between TGA/TIFF in the save dialog.
[*]Increased maximum resolution to 4096x4096. Out of memory checks are now in place to prevent crashes. I do NOT recommend working at such resolution, it is too time/memory consuming. Just 1 node at 4096x4096 will need 256 MB of RAM so you do the math.
[*]Optimization: eliminate memory use when saving image to disk.
[*]Fix: mouse wheel functionality on Windows build is now working *COUGH*implemented*COUGH*
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.04 now live.
notes.content:
[list]
[*]You can now copy/paste nodes.
[*]Textboxes now support standard editing with mouse and keyboard.
[*]Enabled mouse wheel for scrollbars.
[*]New modifier, RadialBlur. It's mostly eye candy since it's useless for making tileable textures. Still, it's a favorite of mine.
Load the radialblur.xml from the examples folder to see what I mean. It's the kind of effect that looks even better in motion.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.02 now live
notes.content:
1. All sliders now display their current value in a tooltip like box when you hover over it. That value is meant for the user to find his bearings relative to the neutral position.

2. Added a new Mirror modifier to simply flip an image horizontally and/or vertically.

3. In the Transform modifier, split the scaling in two components, x and y.
You will have to fix your current projects that use it.

notes.title: Linux build update
notes.content:
Small update, no change in version.
The location of the program folder now follows XDG standard. (Thanks to DrMcCoy)
The folder will now be XDG_DATA_HOME/zeuxis or
HOME/.local/share/zeuxis
You can safely delete ~/.zeuxis
The config file will be recreated. Or you can move it over to the new location.
